traps: _helpers.tpl is a Go template (Helm); Linguist's other candidate for .tpl is Smarty
templates/deployment.yaml is Go-templated YAML: not valid YAML until Helm renders it
the chart's postgresql dependency is a Bitnami chart from an OCI registry; the database itself is deployed by it (condition postgresql.enabled, true in values.yaml)
Chart.lock is left out: its digest is computed by helm dependency update; resolved is null
version 0.3.0 is the chart's version, appVersion 1.4.2 the application image tag it defaults to
k8s/ is a Kustomize base, not a chart: kustomization.yaml overrides the image tag to 1.4.3 while deployment.yaml says 1.4.2
kubeVersion >=1.27.0-0 constrains the cluster, not a tool on the machine: no toolchain
the application image ghcr.io/acme/shop-api is built elsewhere: no code unit in this repository
the database URL comes from a Secret (shop-db) that is not in the repository
